==Dialogue==
:''"Drat that [[Ajambo]]! He put lodestones in my wagons to slow me down. The man can't stand a woman beating him at trade. He just can't keep up, that's all. I'm going to play his own trick against him. If you bring me 5 Sandblasted Lodestones, I can balance out my wagons and make it to town just as fast. Plus I'll have my lodestones and his to sell to the farmers there! That will fix Ajambo. If you get them for me, I'll trade you some of my goods:"''
